hypotheses.persona: Hybrid Office Worker (4-day WFH, Fri Office)
hypotheses.rationale: Object_17 (likely keys/bag) at receptacle_11 (exit) at 11:44 on Friday confirms the office departure. The 9-day absence of this event (Days 2-10) establishes a clear Mon-Thu WFH block. The late departure (11:44 vs 08:41 in Week 1) suggests a flexible start or remote morning routine before commuting.

hypotheses.persona: Remote Worker with Variable Office Days
hypotheses.rationale: While the Friday departure fits, the strict 4-day absence pattern is less likely to be purely variable meetings and more likely a fixed schedule. However, the late departure time leaves slight room for ad-hoc scheduling.
Contradicted by the Friday departure. The resident is not on leave; they are working, just from home for most of the week.
